description.en: Marked incongruence between experienced and assigned gender
description.hi: अनुभव किए गए और सौंपे गए लिंग के बीच स्पष्ट असंगति

icd11Chapter: Chapter 17: Conditions related to sexual health
mappingNote: ICD-11 codes by life stage: Gender incongruence of adolescence or adulthood is HA60; gender incongruence of childhood is HA61; unspecified is HA6Z (Appendix A §12.2). ICD gender incongruence is a different construct from DSM gender dysphoria and does not require the same distress/impairment criterion; it sits outside Chapter 06. Gender diversity alone is not a mental disorder.
